capabilities: Import Markdown, TXT, PDF, web pages, audio/video and personal notes as canonical Raw sources
Generate wiki candidates via an LLM agent and review page-level diffs before applying
Link Source, Concept, Entity and Synthesis pages with validated WikiLinks
Query the wiki with an index-guided agent that verifies citations
Run commands like /ingest, /lint, /reindex and /query from a command box
disambiguation: Not a wiki publishing tool; it is an ingestion-and-review pipeline where an LLM agent proposes knowledge pages that a human approves before they are written.
extras: Desktop-only plugin; README is written in Chinese. Sends Raw/Wiki context to the user-configured LLM API during Ingest and Query, and may upload PDFs, audio or video frames to MinerU, ASR or vision services, which it documents in a security section. API tokens are stored in Obsidian Secret Storage; no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in workflow for turning diverse sources into reviewed, evidence-backed wiki pages while keeping traceable provenance for each claim.

requires.name: Anthropic Messages or OpenAI-compatible API with native tool calling
FFmpeg/FFprobe, MinerU, yt-dlp or Whisper ASR for media parsing
MinerU Cloud for scanned or complex PDFs

summary: LLM-agent pipeline that ingests documents, web pages, audio/video and personal notes into a reviewable, WikiLink-linked Markdown knowledge base with source traceability.
